text: DSH Task Notify（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：为 DeepSeek Harness 任务提供桌面提醒。它监听会话与后台作业事件，在一轮正常结束、需要回答或审批时通知；作业仍运行时会等待完成。通知优先发到获准的浏览器页面，失败时调用 Windows 系统通知。附带可选托盘启动器，用于启动、打开或停止 DSH。适合 Windows 11 + WSL2 用户。需要 DSH Web profile；浏览器通知需授权并保持页面连接，Windows 回退需 WSL 可调用 PowerShell。

DSH Task Notify alerts DSH Web users when turns finish, questions or approvals need attention, and jobs complete. It sends browser alerts with Windows fallback. An optional tray launcher starts or stops DSH. For Windows 11 + WSL2; browser alerts need permission and a connected page.
想在 DSH 一轮任务结束时收到桌面提醒。
切到别的窗口后，怎么知道 DSH 已经跑完？
让 DSH 在有操作等我审批时通知我。
DSH 问了我问题但我没看见，能提醒一下吗？
后台作业还在运行时先别报完成，等它结束再提醒。
Notify me when a DSH turn finishes while I am in another window.
Can I get a desktop alert when an approval is waiting?
Let me know when DSH asks a question or finishes its background work.
DSH Task Notify 的功能「任务结束提醒」：会话的一轮正常结束后发送桌面通知；取消、出错或委派子任务结束不会触发。浏览器通道不可用时回退到 Windows 通知。
DSH Task Notify 的功能「待处理提醒」：出现审批请求或向用户提问后开始计时，持续 5 秒仍未处理就发送对应通知；问题保持未答时，正常结束通知也会标示等待回答。
DSH Task Notify 的功能「后台作业完成提醒」：跟踪当前用户请求以来注册的后台作业；若一轮结束时作业仍运行，就暂缓完成通知，待作业结束且宽限时间过后再提醒。
DSH Task Notify 的功能「Windows 托盘启动器」：可选托盘程序可启动或停止 DSH Web、打开本地页面，并提供托盘图标和菜单；安装脚本可创建桌面快捷方式或登录时显示图标。

dsh-task-notify README · DSH Task Notify · 任务完成通知：> **本仓库已迁移到 [dsh-sentinel](https://github.com/herenfor/dsh-sentinel)，这里不再更新。** 新仓库负责 DeepSeek Harness 主程序之外的照看：任务完成提醒、托盘启动，以及开发中的崩溃提醒和救援。
>
> 迁移：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-task-notify`，再 `dsh plugin --profile web add github:herenfor/dsh-sentinel#v0.1.0`，重启 DSH。通知设置会保留。

section: DSH Task Notify · 任务完成通知

text:
dsh-task-notify README · DSH Task Notify · 任务完成通知：插件优先使用浏览器通知。如果浏览器没有打开、没有通知权限，或者发送失败，就改用 Windows 系统通知。你可以切到别的窗口做事，收到提醒后再回来查看结果。

这是一个社区插件，目前主要在 **Windows 11 + WSL2** 环境下使用。
section: DSH Task Notify · 任务完成通知

text:
dsh-task-notify README · 功能：- 一轮对话正常结束时发送通知，取消、出错和委派的子任务结束时不提醒。
- 本轮启动的后台任务（比如编译）还在跑时，结束的这一轮不提醒；等任务结束、AI 处理完结果后再提醒一次。
- 需要你出面时也会提醒：有操作等你审批、AI 向你提了问题，或者本轮结束时还有问题没回答。5 秒内就处理掉的不提醒。
- 支持 Web 模式里的 minimal 预设，AI 没有工具也能触发。
- Windows 通知使用 DSH 名称、鲸鱼图标和默认提示音。
- 通知失败不会影响任务运行。

通知只负责说明发生了什么，暂不支持点击通知后跳转到对应对话。

dsh-task-notify README · 使用环境：支持 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 及之后的 `0.2.x` 版本（`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`），小版本更新不用等插件发新版；实际验证过 `0.2.0-rc.2`、`0.2.1-rc.2`、`0.2.1-rc.3` 和 `0.2.1-rc.4`。主要在 Windows 11 + WSL2 下使用，DSH 运行在 WSL 中；`rc.3`、`rc.4` 兼容验证使用 Node.js `22.23.4`。

使用前需要：

- DSH 的 `web` profile，以及 DSH 支持的 Node.js 版本。
- 安装插件时，WSL 能找到 `pnpm`。
- WSL 能运行 Windows 程序，以便发送 Windows 通知。

Web 里的 minimal 预设可以使用。独立的 `headless`、`sdk` 和 `sdk-minimal` profile 暂不支持。

dsh-task-notify README · 安装：在 WSL 终端运行：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:herenfor/dsh-task-notify#v0.0.6
```

安装后，等当前任务结束，再重启 DSH 并刷新浏览器页面。插件会自动加载，无需手动添加源码路径。

如果之前用本地路径手动加载过测试版，请删除 profile 中旧的 `task-notify` 条目，避免它覆盖新安装的版本。

dsh-task-notify README · 开启浏览器通知：1. 打开 DSH 的 **设置 → 任务通知**。
2. 点击 **启用浏览器通知**，在浏览器提示中选择允许。
3. 点击 **测试通知**，确认能收到提醒。

浏览器通知的标题说明发生了什么：`DSH · 本轮已完成`、`DSH · 等你回答`（本轮结束，还有问题没回答）、`DSH · 需要审批` 或 `DSH · 需要你回答`，能获取到对话标题时会一起显示。测试通知会标为 `DSH · 通知测试`。

浏览器通知需要有一个 DSH 页面保持连接。关闭所有页面、关闭浏览器通知，或未授予权限时，插件会使用 Windows 通知。

通知权限按浏览器和网站地址分别保存。换了浏览器、端口或域名，需要重新允许通知。页面应通过本机 `localhost` / `127.0.0.1` 或 HTTPS 打开。

dsh-task-notify README · Windows 通知：默认使用 Windows 自带的 **PowerShell 5.1**，支持中文，不需要额外安装模块。通知会显示 `DeepSeek Harness` 和鲸鱼图标，提示“任务已完成”“等你回答”“需要审批”或“需要你回答”。

如果这条路径失败，插件会再尝试 **pwsh + BurntToast 1.1.0**。想启用这条备用路径，可以在 Windows 的 pwsh 中运行：

```powershell
Install-Module BurntToast -RequiredVersion 1.1.0 -Scope CurrentUser
```

浏览器通知的声音取决于浏览器和 Windows 设置；Windows 保底通知使用默认提示音。如果没有看到通知或听到声音，也可以检查系统通知设置和勿扰模式。

dsh-task-notify README · 托盘图标（可选）：插件包里还带了一个可选的 Windows 托盘图标，把 DSH 当成一个普通应用来用：

- 双击启动：DSH 没在运行就先启动它，然后打开网页；已经在运行就直接打开网页；
- 单击图标打开网页；右键菜单“停止 DSH”会停掉 DSH，图标也一起退出；
- 菜单跟随 Windows 的深色/浅色模式。

它不是 DSH 插件，需要单独安装一次。在 WSL 里运行：

```bash
bash ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-task-notify/tray/install.sh
```

dsh-task-notify README · 托盘图标（可选）：文件会复制到 `%USERPROFILE%\DshTray`。安装时会问两件事：要不要在桌面创建“DSH”快捷方式（默认要），以及要不要开机时显示托盘图标（默认不要；开机只显示图标，不启动 DSH）。也可以直接用 `--desktop` / `--no-desktop`、`--autostart` / `--no-autostart` 指定；DSH 不在 3080 端口时用 `--port`。之后双击桌面上的“DSH”，或者 `%USERPROFILE%\DshTray` 里的 `start-dsh-tray.vbs` 启动。

托盘默认用 `dsh web --no-open` 启动 DSH，它只负责启动和停止，不会升级 DSH。如果你有自己的启动脚本，可以在 `~/.config/dsh-tray/env` 里改用它：

dsh-task-notify README · 托盘图标（可选）：```bash
DSH_TRAY_START='my-launcher --no-open'   # 需要自己转入后台
DSH_TRAY_STOP='my-launcher stop'
DSH_TRAY_LOG="$HOME/.cache/my-launcher.log"   # 启动脚本写入 "dsh web: <地址>" 的日志
```

不想要了，删掉 `%USERPROFILE%\DshTray`、桌面上的“DSH”快捷方式和“启动”文件夹里的 `DSH tray.vbs` 即可。

dsh-task-notify README · 卸载：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-task-notify
```

卸载后重启 DSH。Windows 中已经登记的通知名称和图标会保留。

dsh-task-notify README · 遇到问题：- **浏览器没有通知**：先点击设置里的“测试通知”，检查网站通知权限。这一步只测试浏览器通知。
- **想单独测试 Windows 通知**：在插件源码目录中，从 WSL 运行 `./notify-windows.sh`。
- **安装后看不到“任务通知”设置**：确认正在使用 `web` profile，已重启 DSH 并刷新页面；检查是否还留有旧测试版的手动配置。

仍有问题，可以到 [Issues](https://github.com/herenfor/dsh-task-notify/issues) 反馈，附上 DSH 版本、浏览器和复现步骤。分享日志前，请去掉凭证、私有启动链接和会话信息。
dsh-task-notify README · 参与开发：想了解实现细节、从本地安装或打包，可以看 [开发说明](DEVELOPING.md)。提交修改前可以参考 [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md)，版本变化记在 [更新记录](CHANGELOG.md) 中。
dsh-task-notify README · 许可证：代码采用 [MIT](LICENSE) 许可证。鲸鱼图标来自 DeepSeek Harness，出处和原始许可见 [第三方声明](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。本项目不是 DeepSeek 官方插件。

dsh-task-notify README · DSH Task Notify：> **This repository has moved to [dsh-sentinel](https://github.com/herenfor/dsh-sentinel) and is no longer updated.** The new repository looks after DeepSeek Harness from outside its main process: task completion notifications, a tray launcher, and crash alerts and recovery (in development).
>
> To migrate: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-task-notify`, then `dsh plugin --profile web add github:herenfor/dsh-sentinel#v0.1.0`, and restart DSH. Your notification settings are kept.

dsh-task-notify README · DSH Task Notify：[](LICENSE)
[](#requirements)
[](https://github.com/herenfor/dsh-task-notify/actions/workflows/test.yml)

[中文](README.md) | English

Get a notification when DeepSeek Harness finishes a turn.

The plugin tries browser notifications first. If no connected page can send one, or delivery fails, it falls back to a Windows notification. You can work in another window and come back when the notification arrives.

This community plugin currently targets **Windows 11 + WSL2**, with DSH running in WSL.

dsh-task-notify README · Features：- Notifies after a turn finishes normally. Cancelled turns, errors, and delegated child sessions do not trigger notifications.
- A turn that ends while background jobs it started (such as a build) are still running does not notify; you are notified once the jobs finish and the AI has handled the results.
- Also notifies when you are needed: an action is waiting for your approval, the AI asked you a question, or a turn ended with a question still unanswered. Anything you handle within 5 seconds is not announced.
- Works with the Minimal agent preset in the Web profile, even when the AI has no tools.
- Windows notifications use the DSH name, whale icon, and default notification sound.
- Notification failures do not affect the task.
dsh-task-notify README · Features：Notifications only say what happened. Clicking a notification does not take you to the conversation.

dsh-task-notify README · Requirements：Supports DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` and later `0.2.x` releases (`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`), so small DSH updates do not need a new plugin release; tested on `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.3`, and `0.2.1-rc.4`. The plugin mainly targets Windows 11 + WSL2, with DSH running in WSL. Compatibility checks for `rc.3` and `rc.4` use Node.js `22.23.4`.

You need:

dsh-task-notify README · Requirements：- DSH's `web` profile and a Node.js version supported by DSH.
- `pnpm` available in WSL when installing the plugin.
- WSL interoperability with Windows programs for the Windows fallback.

The Minimal preset within the Web profile is supported. The separate `headless`, `sdk`, and `sdk-minimal` profiles are not currently supported.

dsh-task-notify README · Install：Run this in WSL:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:herenfor/dsh-task-notify#v0.0.5
```

Wait for active tasks to finish, restart DSH, and refresh its browser page. The plugin loads automatically; no source path needs to be added by hand.

If you previously loaded a test version through a local path, remove the old `task-notify` entry from your profile patch so it does not override the installed version.

dsh-task-notify README · Enable browser notifications：1. Open **Settings → 任务通知** in DSH.
2. Click **启用浏览器通知** and allow notifications in the browser prompt.
3. Click **测试通知** to check that a notification appears.

The title says what happened: `DSH · 本轮已完成` (turn completed), `DSH · 等你回答` (turn ended with a question unanswered), `DSH · 需要审批` (approval needed) or `DSH · 需要你回答` (question asked), with the conversation title when available. Test notifications are labelled `DSH · 通知测试`.

dsh-task-notify README · Enable browser notifications：At least one DSH page must stay connected to receive new browser notifications. If you close all pages, turn browser notifications off, or deny permission, the plugin uses Windows notifications instead.

Permission is saved for each browser profile and website address. Changing the browser, port, or domain requires permission again. Open DSH through local `localhost` / `127.0.0.1` or HTTPS.

dsh-task-notify README · Windows notifications：The default sender uses the built-in **Windows PowerShell 5.1**, with Chinese support and no extra module required. Notifications show `DeepSeek Harness`, the whale icon, and a message saying what happened.

If that sender fails, the plugin tries **pwsh with BurntToast 1.1.0**. To enable this backup, run the following in Windows pwsh:

```powershell
Install-Module BurntToast -RequiredVersion 1.1.0 -Scope CurrentUser
```

dsh-task-notify README · Windows notifications：Browser notification sound depends on the browser and Windows settings. The Windows fallback requests the default notification sound. If notifications or sound are missing, check Windows notification settings and Do Not Disturb.

dsh-task-notify README · Tray icon (optional)：The package also ships an optional Windows tray icon that treats DSH like an ordinary app:

- Launch it: DSH starts if it is not running, then the page opens; if DSH is already running, the page opens.
- Click the icon to open the page. "停止 DSH" in the right-click menu stops DSH and removes the icon.
- The menu follows the Windows dark/light setting.

It is not a DSH plugin, so install it once from WSL:

```bash
bash ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-task-notify/tray/install.sh
```

dsh-task-notify README · Tray icon (optional)：The files go to `%USERPROFILE%\DshTray`. The installer asks whether to add a "DSH" desktop shortcut (default yes) and whether to show the icon at sign-in (default no; it only shows the icon and does not start DSH). `--desktop` / `--no-desktop` and `--autostart` / `--no-autostart` answer these up front, and `--port` sets the port when DSH does not listen on 3080. Then start it from the "DSH" desktop shortcut or `start-dsh-tray.vbs` in `%USERPROFILE%\DshTray`.

dsh-task-notify README · Tray icon (optional)：By default the tray starts DSH with `dsh web --no-open`. It only starts and stops DSH and never updates it. To use your own launcher instead, set it in `~/.config/dsh-tray/env`:

```bash
DSH_TRAY_START='my-launcher --no-open'   # must put itself in the background
DSH_TRAY_STOP='my-launcher stop'
DSH_TRAY_LOG="$HOME/.cache/my-launcher.log"   # where the launcher writes "dsh web: <url>"
```
dsh-task-notify README · Tray icon (optional)：To remove it, delete `%USERPROFILE%\DshTray`, the "DSH" desktop shortcut, and `DSH tray.vbs` in the Startup folder.

dsh-task-notify README · Uninstall：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-task-notify
```

Restart DSH after removal. The display name and icon already registered in Windows remain in place.

dsh-task-notify README · Troubleshooting：- **No browser notification:** Try the test button in settings and check the site's notification permission. This button only tests browser notifications.
- **Test Windows notifications separately:** Run `./notify-windows.sh` from the plugin source directory in WSL.
- **Notification settings are missing:** Check that you are using the `web` profile, have restarted DSH and refreshed the page, and have removed any old test-version profile entry.

dsh-task-notify README · Troubleshooting：For other problems, open an [issue](https://github.com/herenfor/dsh-task-notify/issues) with your DSH version, browser, and reproduction steps. Remove credentials, private startup links, and session information before sharing logs.

dsh-task-notify README · Development：Implementation details, local installation, packaging, and verification notes are in [DEVELOPING.md](DEVELOPING.md) (Chinese). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for contribution guidance and [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for version history.

dsh-task-notify README · License：Code is licensed under [MIT](LICENSE). The whale icon comes from DeepSeek Harness; its source and original license are preserved in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). This is not an official DeepSeek plugin.
